text:
Night is desolation

from the mountains to the sea.

But I, the one who rocks you,

I am not alone!


The sky is desolation

if the moon falls into the sea.

But I, the one who holds you close,

I am not alone!


The world is desolation

and the flesh goes sorrowing.

But I, the one who clasps you,

I am not alone!

translation.title: Night Is Desolation…
translation.editorial_note: Desamparo is kept as desolation rather than mere loneliness, preserving its sense of abandonment and exposure.
